purpose: Teach: 河上/金田/稲本/厚木/江崎/宇野/久留米/青葉

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、河上氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, Dad, you started that joint venture with Kawakami.
lines.style: Gentle, inquiring tone. Settling into memory. Unhurried. Each phrase gives space for reflection, like setting down something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは金田先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father learned so much from Kaneda-senpai's guidance.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Respectful nod in the voice. Steady pace. Honoring both the memory and the mentor — not rushing the moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、稲本氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And in those early years, you planned the overseas expansion with Inamoto.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful. Pause before the name, like turning a page in an old journal. Slow, deliberate. The voice of someone savoring a chapter.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは厚木工場の創設にも尽力された
lines.en: Yes. Father put tremendous effort into establishing the Atsugi factory.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Light emphasis on the factory's name — it meant something. Calm breath. Speaking of legacy with quiet pride, not grandeur.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、江崎家との家族ぐるみの交流があった
lines.en: You had such close family ties with the Ezaki household back then.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wistful sigh. A warm memory held lightly. Slow delivery. The affection in the voice is quiet, like a hand resting on an old photograph.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは宇野氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father made Uno a cornerstone of the public relations effort.
lines.style: Steady, measured. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Even pace. The certainty of someone who witnessed the decision and saw it matter over time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、久留米の研究所を建てられた
lines.en: You built that research facility in Kurume when you were still young.
lines.style: Soft, admiring tone. The voice of someone laying down one more piece of a larger picture. Unhurried. There's quiet wonder underneath — looking at the reach of what was built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは青葉キャンパスの基礎を作られた
lines.en: Yes. Father laid the foundation for what Aoba Campus became.
lines.style: Serene, closing tone. Deep breath underneath. Slow, deliberate pacing. The voice of someone drawing together many threads into one clear legacy — quiet, certain, complete.
